content: {"episode_id":"ep-05088","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency, with diagnosis codes I25.10 and I34.0. We request reconsideration of the CO-97 bundling denial based on this documented clinical indication."}
